verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no dedicated guide for upgrading between incompatible major React versions. The closest items are about incremental adoption of React Compiler and adding React to an existing project, which are adjacent features and not version-migration guides. The axis applies to a UI framework, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can follow a dedicated migration guide when moving between two incompatible major versions of the framework
